title: Water tour
text: Had a great private tour along the river. Nice flat ride with multiple stops to see things we would not have seen by foot. Our guide even took us out of the way for a quick stop at plaza de España which had been closed in the afternoons so to an ongoing festival, would definitely recommend.
author: TracyJosh

title: Not what was expected but a fantastic fusion
text:
Arrived for the tour to find one other couple who had paid for a city bike tour and we only had one guide. We agreed to trust in the guide to give us a mixture of both tours, this did mean we missed out on some of what we were expecting but equally gained from the city aspect. 
It turned out to be better than expected,  a great fusion with lots to see. The parts of the tour we were hoping for, did not disappoint,  it was a fantastic experience and very much enjoyed
author: Bharris1972

title: Easy cycling along river,through parks etc.
text: We especially enjoyed the parks.Our guide was knowledgeable amiable and interesting  .We we’re only participants so it was effectively a private tour
author: Graham_M

title: If you only have time for one tour, take a cycling one.
text:
Fantastic way to see the real Seville.
What a totally enjoyable experience. First day here I took the generic tour bus (yawn!) But second day I booked a cycling tour with the energetic, amiable, knowledgeable and very entertaining Rigo. Cycling in Seville is very pleasurable as there are so many marked cycle ways and other road users are very aware of cyclists. Rigo took me to see all the most important sights and of course being on two wheels we could wind our way through all the back streets of Seville to get up close and personal to the buildings. It was a great history lesson with time to
author: Annette M

title: Excellent tour guide and tour
text: My tour guide, Rigo, personalized the tour.  He was very knowledgeable about history and current Seville.  This was best value of many tours I’ve taken on the trip.  Beautiful way to see Seville.
author: Suzanne_Z

author: Carladtr

title: A wonderful tour of Seville
text: I’m not big on bikes, but husband and 10 year old insisted. I’m glad they did. I am converted. Seville is a beautiful city and a bike tour is a wonderful way to get to see it. It’s flat, with lots of bike lanes and feels both easy and safe (which is what I look for in a city bike tour!) We were so lucky with our guide, Ambra. Her English was perfect and her knowledge of the history of the city was excellent. Do you know where the victims of the Spanish Inquisition are buried? Or what’s hiding under the coat of the statue of Aníbal González Álvarez-Ossorio? Well now I do and my life is enriched
author: ninnynoo9

title: Personalized tour
text: Instead of cancelling the tour for lack of partipants, Javier took the two of us on a tour of all the sites we had not yet had a chance to see, was able to give us explanations for questions we'd accumulated in the previos two days in Seville and gave us directions to the places we wanted to visit in the evening.  He's an architect whose knowledge would do his mother proud.  Thanks, Javier!
author: Judy D
